title: Records manager with create, edit, delete and search
when: The user wants a small app to register and manage records (clients, students, products, members) with a form, a searchable table, edit and delete.
prompt:
Goal: One schema drives a validated form and a sortable, searchable table, with safe edit and delete that survive reloads.
Steps:
1. Define a schema [{ key, label, type, required }] and build both the form and the table columns from it.
2. logic.mjs: validate(schema, data) gives errors per field, upsert inserts or replaces by id, remove, search ignoring case, sortBy(list, key, dir).
3. Inputs use type email, tel, number or date; errors link via aria-describedby and focus goes to the first invalid field.
4. Headers are th scope="col" that sort on click with aria-sort; rows have Edit (fills the form, button reads Save changes) and Delete.
5. Delete needs a second Confirm click; announce "Record deleted" in a role="status" region.
6. Persist in localStorage records.v1, guarded; Export and Import JSON, regenerating clashing ids.
7. test.mjs with node:assert: validation, insert versus update, search, sort, remove.
Quality bar:
- Search filters as you type and says "No records match".
- The table scrolls inside its wrapper on phones.
- Validation lives in the pure function, not only in HTML attributes.
Pitfalls:
- Edit that adds a copy instead of replacing.
- Duplicate ids after an import.
- Columns hard coded in three places.
Verify:
- [ ] Create, edit, delete and search work after reload.
- [ ] Every input has a label and the right type.
- [ ] Headers are th with scope.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (schema, validation, list operations), test.mjs.

examples.input: sistema de cadastro de clientes com nome, email e telefone
examples.output: schema of 4 fields, form + sortable table, edit/delete, search box, records.v1
